stories.title: Union Budget 2026-27 presented on Feb 1
stories.body: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman's 9th consecutive budget, themed on 3 Kartavyas (accelerate growth, aspirations, access to all); fiscal deficit targeted at 4.3% of GDP; capex ₹12.2 lakh crore; first budget presented in Kartavya Bhawan.
